en: The image shows a historical waterfront panorama featuring major architectural landmarks of Istanbul, including the Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque (Sultan Ahmed Mosque). There are ships in the foreground, and the scene appears to be from across the water, emphasizing the skyline of minarets and domes. The postcard is inscribed with handwriting in purple ink and has both printed and handwritten text on its face.
